name: Empty After the Feast

fieldPatches.label: The feast (sugar 0.8 and nutrient 0.2 per cell)

question: What happens when success consumes its opportunity?
expectedObservationsText: Sixty Sprinters scattered on one rich sugar patch. Nothing is added later: when the feast is eaten, it is gone. Diverse Founders: a few founders may start with an extra ability, present at creation.
